subject: Launch coordination: OKRs, milestone owners, and doc sweep cadence
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: release timeline, OKRs, and doc sweep plan

Team —

Kicking this off so we have a single source of truth for the next release. Attached are the initial timeline and an OKR draft; main asks below. Please reply with owner confirmations or suggested edits by EOD Monday.

Quick context: engineering is targeting a staged GA in mid-Jan. We need a coordinated enablement run (docs, SDK samples, release notes), final OKRs for leadership review, and to surface any hard exceptions (compliance artifacts, analytics SDK gaps) that could affect the date.

Asks:
- Confirm milestone owners for the rows in timeline_v1.xlsx (milestone columns are Release Signoff, Docs Ready, SDK Samples, QA Signoff).
- Flag any hard blockers you expect in 3–6 weeks (SOC2 evidence, perf regressions, third-party dependency).
- Agree a cadence for exception triage (proposal: weekly 30-min on Wednesdays).

Known items I already put in the doc:
- Analytics SDK: limited support for streaming telemetry (owner: Ben) — potential rollback plan needed.
- SOC2 evidence: expected to land late Nov; if delayed we may need a limited-region GA.

Attachments: timeline_v1.xlsx, okrs_draft.md

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sr PM, Product Launches
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: release timeline, OKRs, and doc sweep plan

Thanks Marissa — I skimmed the sheet and a few quick notes: 

1) Owners: I can take Docs Ready (writing + release notes) and coordinate sample QA with Mina. Ben taking Analytics SDK is fine. Karthik can own Release Signoff with engineering leads.

2) Exception cadence: weekly 30-min triage works for me. Suggest we add a standing shared calendar and a short Slack thread #launch-exceptions for quick triage outside the meeting.

3) Rollout plan: if SOC2 artifacts slip, we should consider a 1) limited-region GA (US-only) or 2) feature-flag gating for telemetry. Both would reduce scope but keep the date. Flagging this as a decision point for the leadership sync.

Proposed quick reply to your ask:
- Milestone owners: Docs -> Sean; SDK samples -> Mina; Analytics -> Ben; Release Signoff -> Karthik.
- Blockers: SOC2 evidence (risk: 3), Analytics streaming (risk: 2).

Onward —
Sean
Head of Developer Relations
Redwood Inference

+1 on owners and cadence — I accept Analytics SDK as owner. Quick operational note: the analytics team is stretched for the next two sprints; if we keep the full telemetry scope we'll probably need one week of dedicated eng time for the streaming hooks. Otherwise we should scope to batch-only at GA to stay on schedule.

I attached the enablement-checklist PDF I keep for field readiness — it has sample training slots, doc templates, and a pre-GA checklist for CS. Suggest we fold that into the drive doc as a sub-section.

Also, a heads-up: Jessica Park from CloudCorp pinged our CSMs this morning asking whether we can commit to SDK streaming by Jan. I replied we have a public timeline and are willing to prioritize post-GA if needed; copying her below so product has visibility.

Attachment: enablement-checklist.pdf

Subject: Re: Draft: release timeline, OKRs, and doc sweep plan — decisions and next steps

Thanks all — short summary and decisions (so we have a record):

Decisions
- Milestone owners confirmed: Docs -> Sean; SDK samples -> Mina; Analytics -> Ben; Release Signoff -> Karthik.
- Exception cadence: weekly 30-min on Wednesdays, calendar invite to follow (first: 2026-11-25). Slack channel: #launch-exceptions (invite sent).
- Scope contingency: GA proceeds as planned with batch-only telemetry by default; streaming telemetry scoped as post-GA milestone unless Eng dedicates the extra sprint week (Ben to confirm by 11/24).

Action items
- Ben: confirm staffing for streaming telemetry and whether we can spare a dev week (due 2026-11-24).
- Sean + Mina: create Docs Ready outline and sample QA plan in the Drive doc (drive link above) by 2026-11-23.
- Karthik: align release signoff checklist with Eng leads and raise any infra risk tickets (LAUNCH-342) by 2026-11-26.
- Marissa: compile final OKRs and send to leadership Friday 11/27.

Attachments: timeline_v1.xlsx (updated), okrs_draft.md (updated).

Thanks — please flag anything I missed.

Marissa Cole
Sr PM, Product Launches
Redwood Inference
